pages.title: What It Gives
pages.text:
Verbs nothing else has. Light, flight, transmutation, and automation without machinery.

It is slow to start, and its deepest branch sits on the horror seam by design.

pages.title: Your First Hour
pages.text:
1. Type /guide and take the Tattered Tome.
2. Make a NOVICE SPELL BOOK.
3. Grow SOURCE BERRIES. Source is your fuel and you will always want more.
4. Build a SCRIBE'S TABLE and learn your first glyphs. Form, then effect.

pages.title: Why It Matters Below
pages.text: The Art is the best answer to the Sealed Floor. Light you carry rather than place, and ways down and back that do not need a staircase.
